description: Abwasserbeseitigungspflicht im Landkreis Vorpommern-Rügen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The data collection contains the areas of responsibility for the obligation to dispose of waste water according to §56 Wasserhaushaltsgesetz with the indication of the responsible special-purpose association or the municipality. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Obligation to dispose of waste water in the Vorpommern-Rügen district" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Abwasserbeseitigungspflicht, Landkreis Vorpommern-Rügen, Abwasserentsorgung. The listing shows 2022-11-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
